title: Gold Falls To $3,600 If Yields Do THIS Next | Nicky Shiels
speaker: Nicky Shiels (MKS PAMP), interviewed by David Lin

macro_themes.theme: Rising real yields headwind for gold
macro_themes.view: Real yields back at 2007 levels and a higher dollar are headwinds, but the selloff is near its end.
Markets pricing hiking cycles in 2026 and 2027 is too aggressive; Williams' dovish comments matter.
G10 fiscal paths are irresponsible; the only way out is currency debasement, which supports a gold premium.
PBOC and Asian central banks backstop gold around 4,000; ETF inflows steady.
A 10-20% equity drawdown would drag gold down initially, which would be the low to buy.
Copper at 15k reflects tight fundamentals and policy uncertainty, not growth.

calls.condition: If 10-year real yields rise another 50bp, gold falls about $500 (to ~3,600).
calls.reason: Model: gold $840 above real-yield/DXY fair value (~3,200), a low premium for the Trump era; debasement, de-dollarization and central-bank buying persist, and the hawkish repricing looks overdone.
calls.quote: if we see sort of you know is 50 basis points higher in that in that real 10 years absolutely I think gold is down …

calls.reason: Multi-year deficit and critical-metal status, but trading as a high-beta gold proxy; industrial thrifting above ~75.
calls.quote: I think if you get a weaker dollar silver really outperforms on that um so it looks interesting here

calls.reason: Structural deficit, no new mines, AI/electrification demand and tariff-driven US inflows; investors want real assets.
calls.quote: that demand story is really attractive to investors

calls.reason: Dollar at a resistance level it has failed at several times; hike pricing too aggressive.
calls.quote: dollar just seems to be up at that resistance level. It's failed that several times before.

notes: Host states 'today on the 30th of September'. Gold 'local high' transcribed as '$45' (likely ~4,500), recorded as resistance. Copper 15k assumed LME $/tonne. Yields: she expects hike pricing to be overdone but gives no explicit TNX call, so it is in macro_themes only. Bitcoin mentioned in passing (rerated 65k to 85k). Medium-term gold target 3600 is conditional on real yields.
